hypotheses.L0_unseen_relation_alignment_is_adjudica: For at least one of Layers 1-3, leave-one-relation-out alignment has held-out relation/template state R2 >=0.30 in every ordered model pair and held-out relation.
hypotheses.L1_rule_edit_generalizes_beyond_alignmen: At an adjudicative Layer 1 or 2, mapped same-rule edits have mean target-effect fidelity >=0.50 and accuracy no more than 0.15 below the target model's own semantic edit.
hypotheses.L2_same_rule_beats_norm_matched_wrong_ru: At an adjudicative Layer 1 or 2, mapped same-rule edits exceed norm-matched wrong-rule edits by >=0.20 fidelity or >=0.15 target accuracy.
hypotheses.L3_final_effect_matches_target_answer_in: At adjudicative Layer 3, the target model's generic answer edit has effect fidelity within 0.10 of the mapped semantic edit and both fidelities are >=0.70.
hypotheses.L4_semantic_correspondence_exceeds_sourc: At an adjudicative layer, mapped semantic edits exceed mapped generic source-answer edits by >=0.20 fidelity.
